decision: Use unique ids then global assignment
why: Code wrappers and absent ids need a fallback with inspectable confidence

decision: Measure isolated mutations over baked Tracks design
why: Isolated absolute probes let us count injected drifts without layout cascades
result: Nine scenarios; zero false positives or missed injections

decision: Tighten empty-node matching and require external verification policy
why: Independent audit found unrelated empty boxes could match and reports could omit states or widen tolerance
result: Policy, coverage and dirty source failures exercised

decision: Ignore unpainted zero-width border colors and styles
why: Original heading color mutation produced four inert currentColor drifts
result: One injected color drift after fix

decision: Replay comparison from bundled hashed captures
why: Hashes alone only verify report integrity; replay checks claimed measurements
result: Passing control and failing replay checks run
